title: New mobile footer checked locally
summary: Ivory mobile footer reviewed at phone widths; desktop dark styling retained.

changes.detail: Verified new mobile palette, centered brand, integrated newsletter, contact rows and link groups.

validation.name: Responsive browser

validation.name: Interactions
validation.detail: Pointer expansion reveals navigation links; Enter collapses them. Intercepted newsletter success correctly disables email input; no actual subscription sent.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: No physical-device or full-site regression. Screenshot includes fixed header/chat overlays. No deployment.
